newsitem.title: USA: Global Telecommunication sets reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Global Telecommunication sets reverse split.

text.p: Global Telecommunication Solutions Inc said its board approved a one-for-three reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding shares.
The company said the reverse split will be effective at 1700 EST/2200 GMT on March 24 and reduce the number of shares outstanding to about 1.8 million shares from the current 5.5 million.
The common will trade on a post-split basis beginning March 25 under the symbol "GTSTD" for 20 business days. Thereafter, the stock will resume trading under its original symbol "GTST."
